text: ok so i want you to drop these pill categories and create icons from svg that bake as sdf for the categories. so its a floor picture that is generic and wireframe like an icon but we know its a floor and we arnt saying the word floor
resolution: Replaced the build menu's floor/wall/ramp/roof/stairs/elevator/pillar/prefabs/water/tower TEXT pills with wireframe ICONS that read as the category without the word. Authored SVG-style path glyphs in runtime/paint/category-icons.ts and baked them into the SDF atlas through the SAME pipeline the Studio paint brushes use (scripts/paint-glyph-source.ts -> rjit bake-icons -> cat.<id> in framework/gpu/icon_atlas.zig + runtime/icons/baked-names.ts), so each tab draws as ONE batched quad rather than a live Graph.Path that re-tessellates every frame. New CategoryIcon component mirrors the kit's BrushIcon (SdfIcon when baked, PathIcon fallback); the category word rides the hover tooltip so the glyphs stay learnable. Verified via rjit ship + shot /editor: all ten glyphs render crisp and the active tab highlights. Ramp reads a touch like a corner at this size — easy tweak if wanted.
